title: Let's build a Chatbot - Blazor Server Baseline (Part 2)

cues.en: In this part of let's build a chatbot in C-sharp using Microsoft Agent Framework, we're going to look at a Blazor server baseline.
cues.zh: 這個使用 Microsoft Agent Framework、以 C# 打造聊天機器人的單元，要建立 Blazor Server 基本版。

cues.en: Baseline meaning that we have an ambition to build multiple frontends and multiple backends, but in order to get going, in order to learn the basics,
cues.zh: 所謂基本版，是因為之後預計建立多種前端與後端，但為了開始實作、學習基礎，

cues.en: a Blazor server project is really a good way to learn, because we don't need to deal with multiple processes
cues.zh: Blazor Server 專案非常適合，因為不必處理多個程序，

cues.en: and so on, and it's a perfect tool as well for internal chatbots, for more public-facing chatbots, we might want to use a different frontend and have a dedicated backend.
cues.zh: 而且很適合內部聊天機器人。如果是對外公開的聊天機器人，可能會選不同前端與專用後端。

cues.en: But let's use it to get going.
cues.zh: 不過就先用它開始。

cues.en: So what we have in our repo, which we introduced in the latest part, is a Blazor server, and it's a standard Blazor server.
cues.zh: 前一單元介紹的儲存庫中，有一個標準 Blazor Server 專案。

cues.en: The only really thing I have changed in that server is that in app.razor I put in that I don't want pre-rendering on,
cues.zh: 我唯一特別修改的是 App.razor，設定不要預先呈現，

cues.en: because it's just annoying if you want to use the Blazor server as is.
cues.zh: 因為直接使用 Blazor Server 時，預先呈現反而容易造成困擾。

cues.en: Beyond that, I have more or less put all the code we need in terms of Blazor in this chatbot page, which we're going to explore in a bit,
cues.zh: 除此之外，Blazor 相關程式碼大致都放在 Chatbot 頁面，稍後會介紹，

cues.en: but else we have a little service for conversations, which will be a dedicated video about.
cues.zh: 另外有一個對話服務，會用專門影片說明。

cues.en: We have a few models about the conversations, which that video will also cover.
cues.zh: 也有幾個對話模型，同樣留到那支影片。

cues.en: And then we have our components.
cues.zh: 接著就是元件。

cues.en: Inside here, we are using the Aspire, so we are getting our dependency injection from Aspire primarily,
cues.zh: 這裡使用 Aspire，因此相依性注入主要由 Aspire 提供。

cues.en: so we get our AI factory from the agent framework toolkit.
cues.zh: 我們取得 Agent Framework Toolkit 的 AI Factory。

cues.en: And we're getting a little bit of setup from a weather map service, so we don't just make dummy tools,
cues.zh: 也設定了天氣服務，不只是建立模擬工具，

cues.en: but actually make a real tool that goes out live and grabs data from a weather service.
cues.zh: 而是透過真正工具，線上查詢天氣服務的資料。

cues.en: Let's run it, and then we'll jump into the code after the fact.
cues.zh: 先執行，之後再進入程式碼。

cues.en: So when we start, because it's Aspire, it of course starts up in our resources, and as of this recording, we only have the Blazor server,
cues.zh: 因為使用 Aspire，啟動後會看到資源清單。在錄影當下，只有 Blazor Server，

cues.en: but you might run this at a point where there's multiple different resources for various frontends and backends.
cues.zh: 但你實際執行時，可能已經有不同前端與後端的多個資源。

cues.en: But if you want to run this, it's in the Blazor server only.
cues.zh: 要執行這個版本，選擇 Blazor Server Only。

cues.en: In order to run it, we need the parameters, so you need to put in an Azure OpenAI endpoint, an OpenAI key, and an OpenWeatherMap service key
cues.zh: 需要設定參數，包括 Azure OpenAI 端點、OpenAI 金鑰，以及 OpenWeatherMap 服務金鑰，

cues.en: in order to run it yourself.
cues.zh: 才能自行執行。

cues.en: So running it looks like this.
cues.zh: 執行後長這樣。

cues.en: We have a classic chatbot interface with some conversations and new chats over here.
cues.zh: 這是典型聊天機器人介面，旁邊有對話與新增對話按鈕。

cues.en: We haven't made any chats yet.
cues.zh: 目前還沒有任何對話。

cues.en: Over here, there's some nerdy stuff with options.
cues.zh: 另一側是比較偏技術性的設定選項。

cues.en: Right now, we only have streaming, but there might come more options as we go along.
cues.zh: 目前只有串流，但之後可能加入更多選項。

cues.en: And streaming in general will be its own video as well, because it requires a little more.
cues.zh: 串流本身也會有專門影片，因為需要多處理一些事情。

cues.en: But what we can do is, of course, we can talk to the AI, ask it hi, get an answer back,
cues.zh: 現在可以和 AI 對話，例如說你好，取得回答，

cues.en: and the answer is here, but we also get what thoughts it had, and what tokens it used.
cues.zh: 這裡除了答案，也會顯示思考內容與 Token 使用量。

cues.en: And there's also tool calling involved, so we can say, what is the weather like in Paris?
cues.zh: 另外也支援工具呼叫，所以可以問：巴黎的天氣如何？

cues.en: Send that along.
cues.zh: 把問題送出。

cues.en: It will now do tool calling.
cues.zh: 接著會呼叫工具。

cues.en: Let's try that again.
cues.zh: 再試一次。

cues.en: OpenAI has been a bit troublesome at this recording,
cues.zh: 在錄影當下，OpenAI 的服務有點不穩，

cues.en: so we're going to see again if we get along. There we go.
cues.zh: 所以再試試看。好了。

cues.en: We saw thoughts, tool calling along the way, so it put in Paris, France, got some data back from that tool,
cues.zh: 可以看到思考與工具呼叫過程，傳入巴黎、法國，再從工具取得資料，

cues.en: thought a bit more about that output, and gave us the final answer.
cues.zh: 針對輸出稍作思考後，提供最後答案。

cues.en: And everything is stored over here, so we can switch, go back and see everything as this is stored.
cues.zh: 所有內容都存放在旁邊，可以切換回去，查看已保存的完整紀錄。

cues.en: So right now, this is stored down in file with a JSON for each one of these conversations.
cues.zh: 目前每個對話都會以一份 JSON 檔案儲存。

cues.en: We can see that conversation here, but we'll go more into this in details in the conversation video.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到對話，但會在對話單元中詳細說明。

cues.en: We can also do streaming, so we can say, how to make soup
cues.zh: 也可以使用串流，例如詢問如何煮湯，

cues.en: and get a streaming answer back to us.
cues.zh: 就會逐步收到答案。

cues.en: So both thoughts are streaming and the real answer is streaming back.
cues.zh: 思考內容與實際答案都會串流回傳。

cues.en: So this is what we have.
cues.zh: 這就是目前的功能。

cues.en: Let's explore various things in overview, and then there are several videos about some of the aspects in details.
cues.zh: 接著先概覽各個部分，其中一些細節會用獨立影片說明。

cues.en: So let's have a look at what we have.
cues.zh: 看看目前有哪些程式碼。

cues.en: So the only thing I put in program CS is these three lines of code.
cues.zh: Program.cs 中只加入這三行。

cues.en: We are taking our conversation service, which is just normal C Sharp code.
cues.zh: 註冊 ConversationService，它只是一般 C# 程式碼。

cues.en: We are doing the service defaults in order to get our Agent Framework dependency injection and our local storage.
cues.zh: 加入 ServiceDefaults，取得 Agent Framework 的相依性注入設定，以及 LocalStorage。

cues.en: So in here, we are just grabbing our keys like we have seen in previous videos about Agent Framework,
cues.zh: 這裡就像之前 Agent Framework 影片一樣，先取得金鑰，

cues.en: and I'm using my Agent Framework Toolkit NuGet package, which takes care of being able to build AI agents.
cues.zh: 再使用我自己的 Agent Framework Toolkit NuGet 套件，協助建立 AI 代理程式。

cues.en: So it's just an initialization of the agent that is a bit different and easier, but using the agent is completely normal as normal Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 只有代理程式初始化比較不同、更簡單，實際使用仍然就是一般 Agent Framework。

cues.en: As I mentioned, I also use OpenWeatherMap, and if you need to grab something from them, you need to go to OpenWeatherMap,
cues.zh: 如前面提到的，也使用 OpenWeatherMap。如果需要使用它，前往 OpenWeatherMap，

cues.en: and you can just sign up for free and get an API key.
cues.zh: 就能免費註冊並取得 API 金鑰。

cues.en: So there's no cost at all in order to run this.
cues.zh: 因此使用這個天氣服務不需要費用。

cues.en: So the system here will ask you for this, and you just put in the keys, and you are ready to go there.
cues.zh: 系統會詢問這些設定，填入金鑰就準備好了。

cues.en: This one we'll cover later, and the local storage is just so we can use the browser's local storage
cues.zh: 這個服務稍後會介紹。LocalStorage 則是讓我們使用瀏覽器的本機儲存空間，

cues.en: in order to save our data in local storage, like settings, so I don't need to turn on streaming every single time I try it out, for example.
cues.zh: 保存設定等資料，例如不必每次測試都重新開啟串流。

cues.en: For local storage, we have a key for that, and there will probably come more keys in here.
cues.zh: LocalStorage 中有對應的鍵值，之後可能加入更多。

cues.en: The conversation service, as mentioned, we'll cover in another session, and same goes for the conversations, but a conversation is more or less just a set of messages
cues.zh: 對話服務與對話模型會留到其他單元介紹。不過對話基本上就是一組訊息，

cues.en: and some more stats about it.
cues.zh: 以及相關統計資訊。

cues.en: I will also, in that video, go into why I'm not using agent sessions from Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 那支影片也會說明，為什麼不使用 Agent Framework 的 Agent Session。

cues.en: We have an extension folder, just to take some of the AI content, which we'll talk about in the tool calling video,
cues.zh: 另外有 Extensions 資料夾，處理某些 AIContent，工具呼叫單元會介紹，

cues.en: but just some handy extension methods in order to work with these a little more easy.
cues.zh: 目前只需要知道，這些是方便操作內容的擴充方法。

cues.en: The main part, of course, is our chatbot.
cues.zh: 主要部分，當然就是聊天機器人。

cues.en: If we look at the chatbot, we have a small design.
cues.zh: 看看 Chatbot 頁面，有一個簡單設計。

cues.en: We have a chat page with a left sidebar, which is out in a component by itself, and that will be covered in the conversation video,
cues.zh: 聊天頁面左側有側邊欄，獨立成元件，會在對話單元介紹。

cues.en: and we have the right sidebar, which is just setting up if we have streaming or not, using local service.
cues.zh: 右側側邊欄則控制是否啟用串流，透過 LocalStorage 保存設定。

cues.en: So this one, we don't really need to cover.
cues.zh: 這個元件就不特別介紹。

cues.en: Whenever we have messages back from a conversation, we will show them in this tier.
cues.zh: 每當對話中有訊息，就會在這裡顯示。

cues.en: So we will show the user parts, which is the right-hand side of a chat bubble message system, and we're going to use the assistant part,
cues.zh: 使用者訊息放在右側對話泡泡，AI 助理訊息則，

cues.en: where we're just going to show the text and the usage tokens out.
cues.zh: 顯示文字與 Token 使用量。

cues.en: So just a normal message with the text out, directly from Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 也就是直接顯示 Agent Framework 回傳的一般文字訊息。

cues.en: But in the other videos, we will look at how we put out reasoning, not the visuals as much, but how we actually get them and why this is more difficult.
cues.zh: 其他影片會介紹如何取得與顯示推理內容，重點不是視覺，而是為什麼取得這些資料比較麻煩。

cues.en: And down here, I have something called mid-turn visuals, which is the streaming process mostly, but also the little dot, dot, dot, when we're waiting for a non-streaming.
cues.zh: 下面是 Mid-Turn Visuals，主要顯示串流過程，也包含非串流等待時的三個小圓點。

cues.en: So this is just the visuals, but of course, in the video about streaming, we are going to look more in detail into that.
cues.zh: 這些只是畫面呈現，串流單元會更詳細介紹。

cues.en: Then we have the form at the bottom, the input form, where we just use normal Blazor.
cues.zh: 再往下是底部輸入表單，使用一般 Blazor。

cues.en: The only thing we do is we use some JavaScript here on key down,
cues.zh: 唯一特別的是，在 KeyDown 事件使用一些 JavaScript，

cues.en: because we can't really use the Blazor version of it, because if we did, we would end up sending
cues.zh: 因為如果直接用 Blazor 處理，就會持續在，

cues.en: between server and browser constantly, and if you type really fast, it would not be able to keep up.
cues.zh: 伺服器與瀏覽器間傳送事件，打字很快時可能跟不上。

cues.en: So the key down here is to be able to press Enter in the field, so we don't need to use the mouse to press the Send button,
cues.zh: 這裡處理 KeyDown，是讓使用者能在欄位按 Enter 送出，不必滑鼠點選，

cues.en: and still be able to use the Shift key in order to make multi-line sendings.
cues.zh: 同時保留 Shift 加 Enter 輸入多行文字。

cues.en: That is the only GUI we have.
cues.zh: 這就是全部的基本介面。

cues.en: Each of these GUI elements we will cover in more details a little later on.
cues.zh: 稍後會更詳細介紹其中各個部分。

cues.en: If we look at the backend part, it's also fairly simple.
cues.zh: 後端也相當簡單。

cues.en: We are taking dependency on our agent factory in order to make AI agents.
cues.zh: 先注入 Agent Factory，用來建立 AI 代理程式。

cues.en: We're taking dependency on the service for the conversations, and the local service, and the web app.
cues.zh: 也注入對話服務、LocalStorage 與網頁相關服務。

cues.en: Behind the scenes, we have an input field in order to put in the input, and we have a conversation, which is just an empty conversation at the beginning.
cues.zh: 內部有輸入欄位，以及一個對話物件，剛開始是空白對話。

cues.en: Then we keep track of if we're streaming, and if we're streaming, what is the streamed response so far, the text gone back, and the streamed reasoning back.
cues.zh: 接著記錄是否正在串流、目前回傳的串流文字，以及串流推理內容。

cues.en: And then we have something called stream content, which is where the tool calls live.
cues.zh: 另外有 StreamContent，存放工具呼叫資料。

cues.en: So we'll cover that in the tool call.
cues.zh: 工具呼叫單元會介紹。

cues.en: Then we have the left sidebar, just so we can grab
cues.zh: 還有左側側邊欄的參考，方便在，

cues.en: whenever we set a new conversation to react to that.
cues.zh: 切換對話時通知它更新。

cues.en: On initialize, we'll just check if we have set streaming in our local storage, so nothing big there.
cues.zh: 初始化時，只檢查 LocalStorage 是否已啟用串流，沒有其他複雜處理。

cues.en: But of course, the big one is the send async, meaning we send a new message.
cues.zh: 最重要的是 SendAsync，也就是送出新訊息。

cues.en: So we just grab our input, trim it, and if no input was found, we will, of course, not do anything.
cues.zh: 先取得輸入並移除頭尾空白，如果沒有內容，當然不做任何事。

cues.en: We will reset a bunch of these values, so whenever we send in something new, it shouldn't show the old streaming and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 接著重設這些值，避免送出新訊息時，仍顯示上一輪串流等內容。

cues.en: Then we are building our agents.
cues.zh: 然後建立代理程式。

cues.en: In our case, we can just call it an AI agent, so it's more easy to understand from the system.
cues.zh: 這個例子直接以 AIAgent 類型表示，方便理解。

cues.en: But we have our agent from agent framework, Azure OpenAI in this case, and I'm just building an agent using responses API.
cues.zh: 實際取得的是 Agent Framework 代理程式，這裡使用 Azure OpenAI，並透過 Responses API 建立。

cues.en: I'm using responses API in order to get the thoughts back in normal chat client.
cues.zh: 使用 Responses API，是為了取得思考內容。

cues.en: We are not allowed to use normal chat client because it can't give us what the reasoning summary was.
cues.zh: 一般 ChatClient 不行，因為它不能提供推理摘要。

cues.en: I'm using chat GPT-5 mini, but you can do whatever, and in this case, I'm using medium reasoning effort.
cues.zh: 這裡使用 GPT-5 mini，也可以換其他模型，推理強度設為 medium。

cues.en: I'm getting all the details of the summary back, and as a tool, I'm using the weather tools, which comes from agent framework toolkit as well,
cues.zh: 摘要設定為取得詳細內容。工具則使用 Toolkit 提供的天氣工具，

cues.en: which is just a weather for city.
cues.zh: 也就是依城市查詢天氣。

cues.en: So behind the scenes, it will call open weather map.
cues.zh: 它在背後呼叫 OpenWeatherMap。

cues.en: I have a separate video about these weather tools in general, if need be, but suffice to say, it's a tool that takes an input of a city
cues.zh: 如果有需要，我有另外介紹這些天氣工具的影片。簡單來說，輸入是城市名稱，

cues.en: and puts an output in JSON format on what the weather is like in that city.
cues.zh: 輸出是該城市天氣的 JSON 資料。

cues.en: So that's our main agent.
cues.zh: 這就是主要代理程式。

cues.en: We also do a little agent because whenever we do the conversations, let's have a look here.
cues.zh: 另外還有一個小型代理程式，與對話管理有關，先看看。

cues.en: Why don't we start it up again?
cues.zh: 不如重新啟動。

cues.en: We want, in our conversation sidebar, to have a title for our conversation, and whenever we did this, how to make soup,
cues.zh: 我們希望對話側邊欄能顯示標題。剛剛問如何煮湯時，

cues.en: it actually used a small agent to take that question and make a title for that, and that's what we're doing here.
cues.zh: 其實使用了一個小代理程式，把問題轉成標題，這裡就是實作。

cues.en: So if we are missing a title, meaning there is no title yet in the conversation, because it's a new conversation, we just make a small title generation agent.
cues.zh: 如果還沒有標題，代表這是一段新對話，就建立小型標題生成代理程式。

cues.en: In this case, I'm using a 4.1 nano, the smallest model I have available right now, and just saying, giving the following message,
cues.zh: 這裡使用 GPT-4.1 nano，是目前可用的最小模型。指示是，根據下面這則訊息，

cues.en: generate a max 25 char long title for this question.
cues.zh: 產生最多 25 個字元的標題。

cues.en: So we're just doing that using structured output here, and we're just using that response in order to get our title.
cues.zh: 透過結構化輸出完成，再從回應取得標題。

cues.en: And then we add the conversation, so when a new conversation actually have something, we show it up in the left sidebar.
cues.zh: 接著加入對話，讓新對話真的有內容時，出現在左側側邊欄。

cues.en: We then put the new message into our conversation, so it has the full back and forward, and we are updating the GUI in order to see that new conversation,
cues.zh: 再把新訊息放進對話，保留完整來回紀錄，並更新介面，

cues.en: so we can look at our question before the answer comes back.
cues.zh: 讓答案回來前，就能先看到自己的問題。

cues.en: Then there's two ways of doing this, either streaming or non-streaming.
cues.zh: 接著有兩種處理方式：串流或非串流。

cues.en: Non-streaming is very simple, in that we just get our chat messages from our previous conversation, send them along so it has the full context,
cues.zh: 非串流很簡單，把前面對話中的 ChatMessage 全部傳入，讓模型取得完整上下文，

cues.en: and once we get the results back, we just put it back into the conversation, meaning we take all the messages from our response,
cues.zh: 取得回應後，再把回傳的所有訊息，加入對話，

cues.en: and put in the usage on the last message.
cues.zh: 並在最後一則訊息附上用量資訊。

cues.en: If it's streaming, it's more complicated, which I will leave to the streaming video, but essentially we are using the streaming in Agent Framework,
cues.zh: 串流較複雜，留到串流單元。基本上使用 Agent Framework 的串流功能，

cues.en: but need to do a bunch of extra stuff in order for it to really work.
cues.zh: 但還要額外處理不少事情，才能完整運作。

cues.en: Once we're done with either streaming or non-streaming, we do an invoke, so our user interface will update,
cues.zh: 無論串流或非串流完成，都會呼叫更新，讓介面重新呈現，

cues.en: and then we're storing the conversation down into some files.
cues.zh: 接著把對話存入檔案。

cues.en: So nothing really more is happening here.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有更多其他處理。

cues.en: Whenever we press the new chat, we of course just make a new conversation.
cues.zh: 按下新增對話時，就建立新的 Conversation。

cues.en: When we want to switch to an existing conversation, we just do that from the left sidebar, and set that as the active conversation.
cues.zh: 切換到已有對話時，從左側選擇，再設定為目前對話。

cues.en: If the streaming is set over on the right side, we set that value and save it in local storage, and once we start new things,
cues.zh: 右側設定串流時，更新值並存入 LocalStorage。每次開始新操作，

cues.en: we of course need to reset various values.
cues.zh: 也要重設各種狀態值。

cues.en: So that is everything.
cues.zh: 這就是全部內容。

cues.en: Again, I want to go into the reasoning, the tool calling, and the conversation on why I've done it the way I've done it
cues.zh: 之後會分別介紹推理、工具呼叫與對話管理，解釋為什麼，

cues.en: in three separate small videos after this.
cues.zh: 採用這些做法，總共三支短影片。

cues.en: But now you have the baseline of what we are about to build, in this case in Blazor Server, but later on we'll see how this evolves
cues.zh: 目前已經有之後要擴充的基本版，這次使用 Blazor Server，往後會逐漸演變成，

cues.en: into multiple backends and multiple frontends.
cues.zh: 多種後端與多種前端。

cues.en: See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 下一支影片見。
